title: Study a word within a paragraph
subtitle: Start locally before widening the search.
overview: A responsible word study begins with the immediate clause and paragraph: form, construction, contrast, repetition, and authorial argument.
Only then compare other occurrences. A collection of dictionary glosses is not a word study unless it explains the word’s work in the passage.

sections.title: Local-first study
rows: Record governing verb, preposition, or modifier.
State contrast, repetition, or argumentative role.

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν.
items.en: Begin with the genitive phrase and the verb “has been poured out” in Romans 5.
